version_notes: v2 post deep dive corrections. 3 products adjusted: Bosch Benchmark 80→79, JennAir 66→70, Dacor 53→56.
axis_notes: Durability dominant — professional hierarchy organized around reliability and serviceability. Yale service rate data is the anchor metric. Performance NOT flat: temperature uniformity, noise, humidity retention, usable capacity all have real spread.

anchors.rationale: Clear #1 by every professional metric. Dual Embraco compressors (variable-speed 2023+ via Split Climate™), 5yr/12yr warranty, parts since 1986, NASA air scrubber, zero DOA in 38 years at Yale.
BSH platform (Turkey), dual compressor, best flush-integrated aesthetic. Yale 'A' grade, ~8% less reliable than Sub-Zero. Lower anchor of Tier 1.

Same BSH platform as Thermador. 0.4% 5yr compressor failure (lowest Yale tracks). BUT: only 1yr full warranty (Thermador gets better from same factory), iService5 proprietary diagnostic restricts service ecosystem. Entry premium.
Whirlpool platform with variable-speed inverter (genuine differentiator). Obsidian stainless interior. 12yr sealed system warranty. Class action evaporator defect does NOT apply to column models.
Samsung platform — complete convergence (every part DA97/DA94 prefix). SteelCool stainless interior. Column has NO ice maker. 15yr compressor parts warranty. Fan-freezing design flaw acknowledged.
>60% first-year service rate (Yale, multiple years). CR #25 of 25, score 34/100. Does not manufacture own refrigerators. Systemic QC failure.

tier_5.label: Below Standard
tier_5.notes: No built-in refrigerator scored in Tier 5 during calibration. Samsung Bespoke freestanding would likely anchor here but is out of scope (built-in only).

compressor_architecture.notes: Dual independent compressors separate Tier 1 from everything below.

compressor_oem.notes: Embraco = longest track record in built-in refrigeration.

compressor_type.notes: Variable-speed = fewer start-stop cycles = longer life.

parts_commitment_horizon.notes: Sub-Zero parts since 1986. Dacor 15yr compressor parts.

service_network.notes: Bosch Benchmark iService5 = restricted. Dacor = South Korea routing.

ice_maker.notes: Ice makers = #1 failure mode (31% fail within 5yr per CR).

sources: Yale Appliance (Steve Sheinkopf) — service rate data

pool_notes: Pool S vacant for teardown — no StarCraft equivalent exists for built-in refrigerators. Yale is Pool S for service rate data only.
category_specific_rules: Built-in only scope. No freestanding, no counter-depth freestanding.
Dual independent compressor architecture is the primary quality separator between Tier 1 and Tier 2+.
Ice makers are #1 failure mode (31% fail within 5yr per CR). Presence/absence scored on durability axis.
Service ecosystem is a scored durability spec: parts availability + service network + parts commitment horizon.
European brand evidence asymmetry rule applies: Miele, BSH, Liebherr have thinner US lawsuit/complaint evidence. Disclose in reports. No score impact.
BSH Turkish Factory platform disclosure MANDATORY for Miele, Thermador, Gaggenau, Bosch Benchmark reports.
Samsung/Dacor platform disclosure MANDATORY for all Dacor reports.
One deep dive per product line. Column and French door variants of same brand are DIFFERENT products (Rule 19).

bsh_turkish_factory.disclosure: Built-in refrigeration manufactured in same BSH factory in Turkey. Yale Appliance confirmed. Score separately per Rule 19 but disclose shared platform prominently.

samsung_dacor.disclosure: Complete component convergence. Every part carries Samsung DA97/DA94 prefix.

ge_monogram.disclosure: Same Selmer, TN factory. Reddit teardown confirmed same compressor, evaporator, mainboard.

whirlpool_jennair.disclosure: Shared platform. Compressor start device W10448874 cross-applies across portfolio.
